'''Merchandise''' ---- Tower Defense Simulator has '''Merchandise''' themed around the game. The '''Merchandise''' designs are based on elements and characters of Tower Defense Simulator. Tower Defense Simulator '''Merchandise''' is sold on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games website]. There also used to be multiple pieces of clothing available to be bought on the Amazon store. You can buy these pieces of '''Merchandise''' depending on what country you live in. For clothing, the sizes vary, and certain clothing and sizes might not always be in stock.
{{RightTOC}} ==Roblox Developer Conference 2025== ''These were given out by the developers during the Roblox Developer Conference 2025 (and later 2026).
